title: Describe the role of ICD-11 and WHO-FIC where standards are named
requirements:
- Name ICD-11 (not 'ICD') and its role in the 2.2.2 open-standards list
- Add a conditional requirement for native ICD-11 support where ICD-11 is in scope
- Reference the WHO Nomenclature Regulations and Member State reporting obligations
- Describe ICD-11's role in clinical recording with continuity to statistical reporting, where standards are first introduced (1.2.2, 3.6.2)
- Add WHO ICD API/local deployment and the ICD-11 Coding Tool as illustrative terminology tools
- Assess historical codes against the release recorded with the source
- Require profiles to keep code-system namespace, identifiers and post-coordination intact
- Add glossary entries for ICD-11 and its Foundation component
